Q. 3 إِقْرَنْمَطَ , (S,) or إِقْرَمَّطَ, (K,) [the former being the original form,] It (skin, S, TA) became contracted, or shrivelled: (K, TA:) or became drawn together, one part to another. (S, TA.) ―
-b2- He (a man, AA) became angry. (AA, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
